dict.string: Kasset.ai needs access to your microphone to record and transcribe audio.
Kasset.ai records the other participants' audio only while you record a meeting, and keeps it on this Mac.
Kasset.ai needs screen recording permission to capture system audio.
Kasset.ai reads your calendar to notify you about upcoming meetings and help identify speakers during transcription.
